items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I think that's it. Then there was a period -- Julian Priester -- for a minute it looks like and -- that was after -- right after you left, wasn't it? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, that was in '70.

ctx.x: Well, everyone was trying to build up, you know, and there were several bands that had 16, 17 men. And so, a fourth trombone became popular to everything. Made the -- enhanced the musical sounds. So, they got it. Benny was a very good man. Benny for a long time was in a small group. I forget the name of the group. It was very good. I think he's still down in Los Vegas.
Yeah, I think that's it. Then there
was a period -- Julian Priester -- for a minute it looks like and -- that was after -- right after you left, wasn't it?
